messages:
elaine: starting thread to finalize Dedicated Capacity PRD: SLA targets, throughput units, autoscale acceptance. Draft is up: https://redwood.atl/confluence/dedicated-capacity-prd
omar: reading it now. customer asks for a concrete p95 latency guarantee + reserved concurrency. they also want a predictable burst billing model.
kevin: id prefer we avoid hard p99 SLAs for the big families. tails + cold kv are messy and will cause churn.
sasha: proposal: model-class buckets (small/medium/large) with explicit quantization and perf expectations tied to each bucket.
maggie: on our baseline infra, medium/large p95 around 1.5s is more realistic than 1.2s. need exact CSVs from perf runs.
raj: question: should capacity be expressed as reserved RPS or concurrent requests? enterprise contracts typically expect RPS guarantees.
alice: recommend reserved concurrency (RPS) plus a token-based soft cap for burst. example: reserved 100 RPS (small), 25 RPS (large).
omar: acceptance criteria for autoscale: no SLA violations during scale events; max service degrade window <= 30s. require documented fallback to reserved pool.
kevin: also call out batching constraints. max batching delay <= 5ms and batching policies must be included in perf tests so p95 isn't inflated by batching.
sasha: edge case: model weight swaps / cold KV after model swap. PRD must include warming plan and gating thresholds for canary.
elaine: rollout plan: canary 2% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with perf gates at each step (p95, error rate, token-cost delta).
maggie: i'll own the harness. test spec: blast traffic 8-10x baseline for 45-120s then steady-state. acceptance: error spike < 3%, latency recovery within 90s.
raj: billing note: reserved capacity contracts must state failover path to shared capacity at premium unit price. include in PRD and boilerplate contract language.
alice: observability requirements: per-customer p95/p99 dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, per-route traces, alerts for sustained tail increases.
kevin: security/infra edge-cases to call out: hardware preemption, cross-tenant cache isolation, and quantized model regression (FP16->INT8 hallucination risk).
sasha: add model-compatibility checklist before a family can be SLA'd: quality evals, regression thresholds under quantization, and eval on long-context tails.
elaine: action items: eng to deliver latency CSVs for representative models by Monday; maggie to deliver harness artifact; legal to draft failover pricing bullets.
deploy-bot: RFC created: /rfc/dedicated-capacity-prd-1764623345 1 reviewers: @omar @sasha @maggie
kevin: tiny edit: set medium/large p95 target to 1500ms pending maggie numbers, not 1200ms.
sasha: ack. i'll add explicit binding syntax for contracts: "model_version + region + capacity_tier" for predictability.
elaine: thanks everyone 0 i'll update the PRD with these acceptance gates and ping for final sign-off. target merge by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
